validity.researcher_notes: SPEC PROBLEMS on an otherwise real row. (a) LENGTH: sheet has 80.00 km for both twin lines (P7766/P7767). No independent source supports 80 km, and geometry contradicts it: OGJ states the Hasbah/Arabiyah fields lie ~150 km NE of Jubail in ~50 m water, and offshore-technology gives a 260 km 36-in export trunkline to the Wasit CPF (plus ~120 km onshore and ~40 km offshore flowlines cited for different segments). A field-to-plant trunkline for a field 150 km offshore cannot be 80 km. The real per-line length is ~150-260 km; GEM's 80 km is a material underestimate. (b) CAPACITY: 1.00 MMcf/d is an obvious placeholder, not a real throughput. Independent sources give a COMBINED 2.5 bcfd of raw sour gas from Hasbah (~1.3 bcfd) + Arabiyah (~1.2 bcfd) carried by the twin trunklines; a defensible per-line figure cannot be isolated, so no forced fill. (c) REF QUALITY: sheet cites the Aramco *Fadhili* Gas Project page for Capacity/Length/FuelSource — wrong plant (Fadhili is a separate downstream plant; the Hasbah *increment II* feeds Fadhili, but P7766/P7767 are the original twin trunklines to WASIT). That citation should be replaced. GulfPub has no real counterpart (its fuzzy match to 'Jafurah Gas Plant to Riyas' is spurious — different field).

validity.recommendation: Keep the row (real twin-line #2); note FuelSource should read Hasbah + Arabiyah, and verify StartYear (likely 2016, not 2017).
validity.researcher_notes: EXISTENCE: CONFIRMED. Independent sources (OGJ: 'Twin 36-in. trunklines will carry production from the fields to the Wasit gas plant'; offshore-technology Al Wasit Gas Program) establish a real two-line 36-in offshore trunk system from the Arabiyah/Hasbah offshore fields to the onshore Wasit gas plant. P7766 (Pipeline 1) and P7767 (Pipeline 2) legitimately represent the twin parallel trunklines — NOT a duplicate of each other or of any other roster PID. CLASSIFICATION: transmission is defensible — these are large-diameter (36 in), long-distance (150+ km) trunklines; the 12-in wellhead flowlines are the gathering layer, not these. Caveat: they carry RAW sour gas upstream of processing (field-to-plant feed), not processed sales gas — kept as transmission by scale. DIAMETER 36 in: CONFIRMED high (OGJ + offshore-technology, independent). OWNER Aramco 100%: CONFIRMED (Saudi Aramco owns and operates). ATTRIBUTION caveat: FuelSource='Hasbah Gas Field' is incomplete — the twin lines carry combined Hasbah + Arabiyah production; FuelSource should note both. START YEAR caveat: sheet says 2017, but OGJ reports Hasbah commissioned March 2016 and the Wasit plant came online 2015-2016 — likely operating by 2016, not 2017 (minor).

waypoints.name: Intermediate injection/tie-in platform (~25 m water depth) on the trunklines

routes.corridor_desc: Twin 36-in subsea sour-gas trunklines run SW from the Hasbah/Arabiyah offshore fields (~150 km NE of Jubail, ~50 m water depth) across the Arabian Gulf, through an intermediate injection/tie-in platform (~25 m water), making landfall near Jubail and continuing onshore to the Wasit gas plant NW of Jubail Industrial City. Reported trunkline length is ~260 km (offshore-technology); field is 150 km NE of Jubail (OGJ) — so the corridor is ~150-260 km, materially longer than the sheet's 80 km. Endpoints are well-bounded (named field + named plant); exact subsea alignment is not published, so the mid-route bound is loose.
routes.researcher_notes: Endpoints established from independent sources: Hasbah/Arabiyah fields ~150 km NE of Jubail in ~50 m water (OGJ); Wasit plant near/NW of Jubail (offshore-technology, Aramco). Start coord (~28.1N, 49.95E) is APPROXIMATE, derived from the ' 150 km NE of Jubail' bearing/distance and the known Hasbah field area — not a fabricated survey point; treat as field-centroid. End coord (~27.09N, 49.31E) is an approximate plant location (user-mapped source, weak) — treat as approximate. Intermediate platform coord left null (unsourced). No coordinates invented.

summary: P7767 (Hasbah-Wasit twin trunkline #2) is REAL and correctly a 36-in gas transmission trunk, but Length=80 km is materially wrong (real ~150-260 km; field 150 km offshore) and Capacity=1.00 MMcf/d is a placeholder; FuelSource should include Arabiyah and refs are mis-cited to the Fadhili plant page.
